horizon_assumption: 24 hours per stage, for capacity modeling only; user did not specify stage duration

fee_journey_authority_ledger_only.scope: Observed SQLite cursor counters across a warmed two-level principal authorization, signed delivery, status, checkout, x402 offer and one successful simulated fee collection. Includes invoice preflight/claim/completion. Excludes PaidGateway KV/SQL, ProofRail, schema creation, Worker/DO duration, network/gas, retained bytes, invoices, support and tax. One closed-fixture sample, not a production unit-cost invoice.

caveat: A projection from a warmed one-leaf mock journey, not measured production unit cost, an invoice, actual revenue, demand, a purchase authorization or an upper bound for every chain. Deeper chains cost more. Shared account traffic reduces the capacity. No unlimited growth forecast is made.
